open_with: Open on the practical, forward-looking item Mr. Lau himself has on the table: the HKD 60,000,000 equity contribution due 2026-11-01 for the mid-levels redevelopment. Frame it as a planning conversation — confirming funding source, timing, and how it sits alongside his existing holdings — rather than a review of his portfolio's risk profile. This lets him lead with his conviction on the project and gives you a natural, non-confrontational bridge into the concentration and financing metrics without it feeling like a challenge to his judgement.
do_not_lead_with: Do not open with the 49% Hong Kong real estate concentration figure or the 12% single-position mandate breach (Mid-Levels Apartment at 19.58%). Both read as a direct critique of a conviction he has clearly acted on repeatedly and has on file as a strong personal view — leading there risks putting him on the defensive before you've even discussed the new commitment. These points should surface later, as supporting context for why the new equity contribution needs careful structuring, not as an opening verdict on his strategy.
one_number: LTV is at 69.41% against a 70.00% trigger — just 0.59 points of headroom before a margin call, meaning a 5% price fall would breach it. Have this ready as the concrete, time-sensitive figure to anchor the funding conversation once he's engaged on the redevelopment contribution.
